title: FUTO 2026/27 Admission, Student Portal, O-Level Verification & School Fees
summary: FUTO's official student portal published October 2026 instructions for newly admitted students: check admission status, verify the portal account, and generate separate development levy, school-fee and optional hostel invoices. The 2026/27 O-level verification portal is restricted to newly admitted Year One students.
feeNote: FUTO's 5 October 2026 admission/payment notice does not supply one valid university-wide 2026/27 tuition, development-levy or hostel amount. Use the student's own authenticated invoice for each category. Some older supplementary admissions adverts quote fees for earlier sessions; do not reuse those prices for a 2026/27 applicant or confuse an application form with school charges.
timeline: The current student portal contains notices dated 12 September (O-level verification), 28 September (fraud warning), and 5 October 2026 (freshers' payment instructions). Screening and supplementary dates should be checked separately for the candidate's programme.
requirements: Matching JAMB registration number and valid 2026/27 provisional admission recorded through university and JAMB systems.
Correct O-level results uploaded to the JAMB CAPS record; the portal's 2026/27 verification exercise is intended for newly admitted Year One students only.
An active email address and reachable phone number to verify the university portal account, obtain notifications and restore access if needed.
For clearance, originals and copies of JAMB result and admission letters, FUTO result/offer/acceptance documents, birth and local-government records, and valid school-fee receipt as applicable.
steps: Open the official FUTO student portal at portal.futo.edu.ng and choose Check Admission Status; verify the offer with the student's JAMB CAPS record before starting payment.
After a verified university admission, select the portal's Verify Account option or its new-student verification route to activate the student login.
Use the authorised 2026/27 O-Level Verification function only if the admission is into newly admitted Year One; do not re-run it from another academic level.
After the account is verified, select Development Levy, School Fees and Hostel (only if applying for accommodation), and generate the relevant separate portal invoices.
Pay only through the official university invoice reference, then log in again and print matching receipts; never transfer funds to a person claiming to be ICT staff.

Prepare the FUTO and JAMB admission documents and original O-level records for the clearance venue and deadline announced by the Admissions Unit; verify the list with the current faculty before attending.
Once the school confirms admission, payment and clearance, use the authenticated student portal for course registration and keep a copy of each confirmation.
notes: FUTO warns about fraudsters claiming to be ICT staff and asking newly admitted students to pay ₦50,000 to accept admission. This is not the institution's authorised ICT fee.
The 5 October 2026 notice explicitly separates Development Levy, School Fees and Hostel invoices; hostel payment is relevant only when accommodation is being sought.
The official 2026/27 O-level verification message is for newly admitted Year One students, not all returning or Direct Entry students.
The older freshman-registration guidance provides typical documents, but faculty instructions, screening location and current session deadlines take precedence.
FUTO's 2026/27 merit list is published on its official site, but an applicant should use individual portal/JAMB admission records rather than assuming their status from a copied list.

title: FUTMINNA 2026/27 UPASE Screening, Admission Portal & School Fees
summary: FUTMINNA's 2026/27 pre-admission screening (UPASE) ran from 15 June to 9 August 2026 with a ₦2,000 Remita application fee. The university publishes different minimum UTME scores by programme on its screening portal, and admitted students use the separate ePortal for admissions, registration and payments.
feeNote: The official 2026/27 notice sets a non-refundable ₦2,000 pre-admission screening payment through Remita. This is not an admission acceptance payment, per-programme tuition, school charges, hostel accommodation or other student registration fee. No universal 2026/27 tuition rate was confirmed by the screening notice.
timeline: Registration opened 15 June and closed 9 August 2026. These dates are historical as of 12 October; check separate new admissions and resumption announcements on the official university portal.
requirements: FUTMINNA as first choice on the 2026 UTME or Direct Entry JAMB record, in line with the published UPASE notice.

UTME score meeting the specific selected degree programme's 2026/27 portal requirement: the general minimum is 150, but courses such as Medicine, Pharmacy and Software Engineering require higher scores.
Five relevant O-level credits including English Language and Mathematics within a maximum of two sittings; upload O-level results to JAMB CAPS.
For Direct Entry, relevant ND/HND at least Lower Credit or NCE at least Merit, alongside any programme-specific requirements listed by the university.
steps: Open FUTMINNA's published 2026/27 UPASE notice and note that the official registration window ended 9 August 2026; do not pay an unofficial late application agent.
Open the official Post-UTME admission screening portal and consult the specific course's UTME and O-level subject requirements before attempting a new application.

During an explicitly reopened or future authorised cycle, enter the JAMB registration number, verify the programme eligibility and generate the ₦2,000 Remita screening payment reference only inside the university's registration workflow.
Complete the screening form with matching biodata and O-level subjects, submit required records and print the portal acknowledgement for the correct screening session.
Check JAMB CAPS and the university's authenticated student ePortal separately for formal provisional admission; application completion alone does not constitute an offer.

Once admitted, sign in to the student's dedicated ePortal with the institution-issued user account and generate the session, programme and level-specific school-fee or registration reference supplied there.
Follow the current school/faculty clearance checklist and preserve institution-issued payment references, admission documents, examination result copies and verified course-registration records.
notes: The official 2026/27 screening notice gives a general minimum of 150, but the university's live course table is programme-specific: Medicine and Surgery 250, Doctor of Pharmacy 230, Computer Science and Software Engineering 200, and other programmes vary.
Direct Entry applicants require their qualifying ND/HND/NCE evidence, not only a UTME score; course-specific eligibility still applies.
FUTMINNA says false declarations or impersonation in screening can disqualify a candidate; align all names, birth dates and examination results with JAMB.
Do not confuse the 2025/26 undergraduate admission-status option still shown on the general ePortal with a confirmed 2026/27 admission decision.
Remita pre-admission payment, acceptance, tuition and hostel fee are distinct and no third-party payment is processed through MyNigeriaGuide.
